name: pghh-annual-report-2024-25-transition
description: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited (stock-exchange symbol PGHH) Annual Report 2024-25, covering the nine-month financial year from 1 July 2024 to 31 March 2025 between its July-June and April-March calendars, expressed with exceptions.history (fiscalclock 0.2.0). The transition's three quarters of three months, the quarters of the other years and the week block are illustrative: the reports print no quarter or week dates. year_number 'start' is consistent with the report (majority gives the same numbers for the years it states). Only fields this report states are asserted.

source.citation: "The Board of Directors of the Company, on January 23, 2025, approved the change in the Financial Year of the Company from “July 1 – June 30” period to “April 1 – March 31” period. Consequently, the Financial Year of the Company for the period under review, viz., 2024-25, is a period of 9 months commencing on July 1, 2024, and ending on March 31, 2025. Subsequent financial years of the Company shall commence on April 1 every year and end on March 31 of the succeeding year." (Directors' Report, p. 10) "the numbers are not comparable to the previous financial year, which was a twelve months period (July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024)." (p. 10) Establishes the bounds and the label 2024-25 of the nine-month transition year, the bounds of the twelve-month year before it, and that the year after it runs from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 (the first year of the stated April 1 to March 31 rule). The 274-day length is calendar arithmetic on the stated first and last days, not a figure the filing prints. The year before the transition is reached by date and by shift, because its label 2023-24 is inferred; the year after it is reached by shift, because this report does not label it.
